title: The Software Engineering Identity Crisis - Insights with Annie Vella
description:
In this episode, host Simon Maple welcomes Annie Vella, a seasoned software engineer and manager, to discuss the transformative impact of AI on software development. Annie shares her experiences, insights, and the challenges that come with integrating AI tools into coding practices. Discover how AI is reshaping the engineering landscape and what it means for both engineers and managers.

What You'll Learn:
- Explore the role of AI in enhancing coding practices.
- Understand the challenges of transitioning from engineer to manager.
- Embrace new skills to thrive in an AI-driven environment.
- Recognize historical precedents in technology adoption.
- Reduce cognitive load to enhance productivity in software development.

This episode is invaluable for software engineers, managers, and anyone interested in the future of AI in development. Gain insights that will help you adapt to the changing landscape and improve your career prospects.

What are your thoughts on AI's role in software development? Share your perspective in the comments!

[00:00] - Core Skills & the Learning Conundrum
[01:00] - Annie’s Commodore 64 Origin Story
[02:00] - Time-Zone Tango: Scheduling the Recording
[03:00] - Unpacking “The Software Engineering Identity Crisis”
[06:00] - Flow State: Piano Keys, Headphones & Coding Joy
[09:30] - The Reluctant Leap from IC to Manager
[12:30] - First Encounters with AI Tools (Windsurf, Cursor, Copilot)
[18:00] - Productivity Gains vs Code-Quality Headaches
[22:00] - Farewell Linked Lists—Which Skills Still Matter?
[26:00] - Systems Thinking & the Rise of the AI Architect
[33:00] - Trust, Non-Determinism & “Seamful” AI
[39:00] - Testing, Evals & New Guardrails
[45:00] - Future Roles: From Builder to Orchestrator
[51:00] - Wrangling Non-Deterministic Systems & Closing Thoughts
